decision: accepted bounded optional account-verification timeout; full H-10 remains open
behavior: The optional account extension bounds HTTP headers and response-body decoding. A stalled account lookup rejects the upgrade instead of waiting indefinitely. Original shared-secret authentication remains the default.

rootControls.before: Both stalled headers and a partial JSON body remained pending after 450 ms; owned peer was then closed for cleanup.
rootControls.after: Both reject at approximately 150 ms with an explicit 150 ms bound.
rootControls.upgradeCoverage: Each path rejects stalled headers/body, accepts a valid response after each failure, and rejects a revoked account.
rootControls.actualAccountScope: Real Phoenix Account service with private synthetic Store; separate from original native token issuance.

limits: No new native expiry/refetch or persistent robot deployment acceptance.
Timer bounds are event-loop deadlines, not a load-test latency guarantee.
Broader account identity and the complete authentication lifecycle remain tracked separately.
